skills.name: Midnight Skills Router
skills.description: Root router skill for Midnight Network. Use this to select the right sub-skill.

skills.name: Why Midnight
skills.description: What Midnight is, why it exists, and how it works — public/private state, selective disclosure, and ZK proofs.
skills.taskHint: Understand Midnight's architecture, privacy model, and ZK approach
routerBullets: Data protection blockchain with public/private state, selective disclosure, and zk-SNARKs.
Why it exists, how it works, and the privacy guarantees it provides.

skills.name: 1AM Wallet
skills.description: Integrate 1AM wallet for dust-free contract deployment and transaction flow on Midnight Network.
routerBullets: Detect, connect, and wire 1AM browser extension into frontend.
Provider setup, contract deployment, and dust-free transaction flow.

skills.name: React Wallet Connector
skills.description: Scaffold a React + Vite app with DApp Connector API wallet connection, connect/disconnect UI, and unshielded address display.
skills.taskHint: Build a React app with wallet connect/disconnect via DApp Connector API
routerBullets: Scaffold a React + Vite app with DApp Connector API wallet connection.
`window.midnight` enumeration, connect/disconnect UI, unshielded address display.

skills.name: Dynamic Midnight Wallet
skills.description: Scaffold React + Vite with Dynamic.xyz Midnight wallet — unshielded, shielded, and DUST surfaces.
skills.taskHint: Build a React app with Dynamic.xyz Midnight wallet (unshielded, shielded, DUST)
routerBullets: Scaffold React + Vite with Dynamic.xyz Midnight connectors.
Unshielded, shielded, DUST surfaces, balances, send routing.

skills.name: Compact
skills.description: The Compact smart contract language for Midnight Network. TypeScript-like DSL that compiles to ZK circuits.
routerBullets: The four mandatory pieces of every contract, type system, circuits as constraints.
Witnesses, `disclose()`, ledger ADTs, standard library, and security patterns.

skills.name: Testing
skills.description: Debug Compact contracts and manage toolchain versions. Static vs dynamic errors, version sync, common traps.
skills.taskHint: Debug Compact contracts, read errors, manage versions
routerBullets: Static vs dynamic errors, reading compiler messages, `--skip-zk` dev loop.
Version management across 6 components, common debugging patterns.

skills.name: Multinetwork
skills.description: Build a single dApp that deploys across all networks (localnet, preview, preprod, mainnet) from one codebase.
skills.taskHint: Build a single dApp targeting all networks from one codebase
routerBullets: Unified provider builder, wallet abstraction, proof server routing.
Contract registry, deploy scripts, DUST flow per network.

skills.name: Midnight.js
skills.description: TypeScript SDK — provider wiring, wallet SDK, contract deployment, DUST flow, testkit.
skills.taskHint: Wire up SDK providers, wallets, deploy/call contracts
routerBullets: TypeScript SDK: provider wiring, wallet SDK (HDWallet, WalletFacade, Shielded/Unshielded/Dust).
Contract deployment, circuit calls, DUST generation, private state, testkit.

skills.name: Indexer
skills.description: Query and subscribe to Midnight blockchain data via Indexer GraphQL API v4.
skills.taskHint: Query blockchain data, watch contract state, subscribe to events
routerBullets: GraphQL queries and subscriptions, contract state reads, transaction lookups.
Real-time event watching, offset/null bug workaround, TypeScript helpers.

skills.name: Security
skills.description: Privacy audit checklist, data leak patterns, defensive Compact patterns.
skills.taskHint: Privacy audit checklist, prevent data leaks, defensive Compact patterns
routerBullets: Privacy audit checklist, data leak patterns, commitment/nullifier design.
Witness trust, front-running resistance, transaction semantics.

skills.name: Example Counter
skills.description: Complete Midnight DApp reference — headless wallet, CLI, counter contract, DUST generation, deploy, interaction.
skills.taskHint: Complete DApp reference: wallet, deploy, interact (use as template)
routerBullets: Complete DApp reference: headless wallet, CLI, counter contract.
DUST generation, deploy, interaction, standalone mode.

skills.name: Example Hello World
skills.description: Build a complete Midnight Network hello-world DApp from scratch with Compact, vitest, and FluentWalletBuilder.
skills.taskHint: Build a complete Midnight Network hello-world DApp from scratch using Compact smart contract, headless Node.js tests with vitest, and testkit-js FluentWalletBuilder.
routerBullets: Build a complete Midnight Network hello-world DApp from scratch using Compact smart contract, headless Node.js tests with vitest, and testkit-js FluentWalletBuilder.

routerBullets: Build a privacy-preserving payment vault: users deposit/withdraw tNIGHT through a Compact smart contract with zero gas fees via the 1AM wallet.

skills.description: Time-lock vault dApp: lock unshielded NIGHT until a Unix deadline; beneficiary releases via blockTimeGte.
skills.taskHint: Build a time-lock vault dApp on Midnight
routerBullets: Time-lock vault: lock unshielded NIGHT until a Unix deadline; beneficiary releases via `blockTimeGte` and witness auth.
